title: Multicentre Registry of Patients With Spontaneous Acute Intracerebral Hemorrhage in Catalonia (HIC-CAT).
brief_summary: A population-based registry in Catalonia of patients with acute spontaneous Intracerebral Hemorrhage, to investigate whether type of center and time from onset to admission is associated with functional outcome and mortality.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with a diagnosis of spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage who is diagnosed in any of the participant hospitals

Exclusion Criteria:

* Traumatic intracerebral hemorrhage
* \>24 hours from onset to admission
* Prior Rankin scale score \>3
study_population: All patients with a diagnosis of acute spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage in Catalonia during a period of 2 years
